# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | Yes                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of this project seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please do not disclose it publicly or open an issue on the public issue tracker.

### How to Report

Please report security vulnerabilities by using GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting on this repository if enabled, or by emailing the maintainers directly.

When reporting, please include:
- A description of the issue and potential impact
- Detailed steps to reproduce or a minimal proof of concept
- Any potential remediations or patches you have identified

### Response Timeline

- You should receive an initial acknowledgment within 48 hours.
- A fix or mitigation will be developed and reviewed in private.
- A public release and advisory will be coordinated after verification.
